instances.claim: This tells me that the object had been under some threat of ceasing to exist — dissolved, dematerialized, destroyed — and that it came through it anyway.
instances.why: "Remained" and "buoyed into physicality" are both recoveries from a prior state, but nothing before line 5 puts the object at risk: lines 3 and 4 only assert how common and how reproduced it is, which is a claim about ubiquity, not about survival. The destruction that would license the verb appears only at line 14, nine lines later and as one item in a list, so at line 5 the push-against has no antecedent.

instances.claim: This tells me that the draft has put in front of me a bounded set of Cent objects — multiple, editioned, made alike at the outset — whose membership I could count.
instances.why: "Every Cent" and "Each object, initially identical" are claims about a population, and the only object the draft has introduced is a singular one: "one cent" (line 2), "the readymade he chose" (line 3). Naming the kind of thing is not introducing the collection, so both quantifiers, and the comparison "initially identical" that line 19 draws across members, quantify over a set the draft never establishes.
